newsitem.title: UK: High winds disrupt loading at Russia's Novorossiik.
newsitem.headline: High winds disrupt loading at Russia's Novorossiik.

text.p: Russia's leading Black Sea oil export terminal Novorossiisk was officially closed to vessels late Sunday due to high winds but ships were still taking on crude and products early on Tuesday, shipping sources said.
"The weather's too bad to take anything into berth one but the two vessels alongside are still loading and a crude tanker is going into berth two this morning," said one.
The Lucky Lady was due to load 80,000 tonnes of Russian Urals crude. Larger vessels would be unable to berth without an improvement in the weather, shipping sources said.
Northeast winds were gusting up to force 10 early on Tuesday, they added.
Maintenance work on the main pipeline supplying the 650,000 barrels per day terminal is tentatively scheduled for October 21-24, the sources said.
But they said the schedule was likely to be subject to rearrangement at short notice.
